binding.source: Captured legal roster and immutable handoff at admission; no later lookup to attract player to ball
binding.when: Model version pinned at opportunity admission before first execution; route/actor/caps/runner contexts sealed before first execution
binding.hashLimit: Hash is a consistency aid, not authentication; reconcile all copies against immutable handoff/roster and authoritative cache

units.time: CRT: existing-family coarse relative arrival. Ball flight origin is upstream launch time=0; later legs use one same-play absolute origin. No seconds or meters claim.
units.movement: MDU: proposed movement-demand index 0..8. Categorical atBase/covering/lateCover/distant; no inferred measured coordinates.
constraints: actor-stage completion/duration finite and nonnegative; current runner relativeArrival may be <=0 (already arrived) and must not be clamped or rerolled; unknown stays unknown, never zero
same timingVersion required for ball, positioning, secure, touch/tag and runner
margin=runnerArrival-contestCompletion; exact ties do not establish retirement
positioning may precede delivery; prototype simplification starts each relay leg at its launch; concurrent-cover design unresolved
Never convert ordinal 2B window into CRT; Delivery/runner timing for that route needs an explicit new authority
units.calibration: Illustrative coefficients not approved; timing extension must be validated in existing RunnerThrowSettlement owner before activation

stages.owner: Existing throw owner emits versioned delivery envelope; Receiver consumes it
required: throw direction or declared coarse accuracy class and provenance
stages.reuse: SS/3B/1B canonical first throw and original release/distance/quality; do not add a new throw success draw
stages.missing: 2B composite and SS relay do not independently establish incoming accuracy; keep C and require new versioned delivery facts before those migrations
stages.offline: No secure attempt. If planned ball path intersects a legal reachable reception envelope, it is a separately declared challengingReceive; do not silently convert an existing offline into onTarget

stages.owner: Proposed pure receiver owner, inside existing DecisionThrow Foundation module; versioned route adapter supplies contexts
preconditions: legal actor and owned start context
stages.note: May position without delivery, but no hands or possession follows missing delivery. Prototype evaluates readiness only when delivered; not a full coverage-misplay authority.

preconditions: no attempt when prior stages unavailable
stages.effort: Separate normative effort projection using frozen average-at-position/league/weather profile, not this player's weak skill nor their sample; calibration required
stages.separation: No arm/throwing input; upstream quality affects demand, never supplies a second chance

stages.owner: Existing RunnerThrowSettlement Foundation via explicit version-aware pure timing validator; ForceAdvancement and Third-Out keep legality
required: current live force or legal tag proof
preconditions: baseTouch needs contact and possession; tag requires runner contact plus declared tag geometry/timing
stages.selfTouch: 3U/5U reuse existing acquisition/touch owner and bypass A/C; arm/throwing cannot improve touch. Do not migrate them in first slice.
stages.limits: Prototype covers admitted initial-out=0 force/baseTouch only; full tag, retreat/reinstatement and third-out runtime remain outside prototype

abilityMapping.stage: B start delay; D footwork only if independently sourced
abilityMapping.career: current reaction is a composite, preserve existing adapter until versioned mapping approved
abilityMapping.NPC: legacy defense alias; label adapter version, not independent reaction skill

abilityMapping.career: current range composite with position differences
explicit approved speed/mobility observation needed; no invented Career field
abilityMapping.NPC: original roster speed exists; mapping to MDU speed still proposed

abilityMapping.pureInput: separate explicit capabilities with source status
abilityMapping.career: ground catching aliases fielding today; incoming player 1B supplies independent catching. Proposed adapter must preserve source distinction.
abilityMapping.NPC: fielding from defense; catching alias may be declared compatibility, cannot claim independent skill

abilityMapping.stage: A existing strength/accuracy / later relay throw
abilityMapping.pureInput: no input to B/C or possession-only self touch
abilityMapping.career: existing observation/composites stay unchanged this sprint
abilityMapping.NPC: arm alias throwing; later relay actor must own its throw

abilityMapping.stage: pre-execution legal cover/target intent, deterministic rule evaluation
abilityMapping.pureInput: no extra success draw for a fixed legal explicit route
abilityMapping.NPC: defense/contact derived value; not independent strategy witness

normativeEffort.basis: Objective average fielder at position/level under same field/weather and ball demand
normativeEffort.cleanCounterfactual: Correct only specified ordinary misplay; preserve runner, upstream strength/release, actual route, frozen capability/context, sample vector and other actors. Do not make fast runner slower or create missing delivery.
normativeEffort.lateReceiverGap: Prototype returns unavailable rather than manufacturing hands failure. A culpable positioning misplay needs explicit responsibility and failure-cause attribution; conservative E/A insufficiency is not permanent receiver-error exemption.
normativeEffort.extraAdvancement: C until runner movement owner produces sourceActionId causal deviation from normal expected destination; initial/final base difference insufficient

rng.A: SHA256 canonical key including original owned sample IEEE754 binary64 big-endian hex, immutable physicalIdentity, fixed model/sampler version, leg and stage namespaces. No additional Match RNG.
rng.B: Same fixed SHA256 namespaces keyed on physicalIdentity without old sample. Pin vector at admission; callback count of upstream execution remains unchanged.
rng.sampling: Sort object keys recursively, preserve arrays; SHA256 first 4 bytes unsigned big-endian; (n+0.5)/2^32; finite [0,1) old sample. Freeze algorithm/version and time quantization before release.
rng.ownership: Leg identity is fixed physical action slot, never rebuilt from selected route or status. Sample vector reused if same slot changes eligibility; unused slots never consume RNG.
rng.identityUniqueness: Require globally unique immutable match/PA/physical contact identity, not hash of secure capability/decision. Null-identity legacy coverage cannot opt in.
rng.tradeoff: B separates receiver variation from legacy reused sample correlation and simplifies fixed-input skill comparison. Deterministic hash is no independence/natural-frequency proof; existing owned sample still bound and stored.
rng.actorTamper: Vector unchanged when actor/ability changes, but sealed actor/ability input change is rejected; no swap-and-reroll.

prototypeCoefficients.runner: Unchanged saved speed/start/progress current deriveRunnerArrival arithmetic; not regenerated random speed
prototypeCoefficients.effort: Average profile=10 and neutral weather are C illustrations. Production bridge must retain insufficient until approved.
prototypeCoefficients.relay: Proposed pivotDelay=1 plus original completed pivot prerequisite; second delivery classes/distance where absent are declared C, not reconstructed historical truth

seamDecisions: New pure receiver APIs may be hosted in existing DefensiveDecisionThrowFoundation; model dispatch remains existing family registry
New timingVersion-specific validation in existing RunnerThrowSettlement; preserve original resolveTiming/deriveSettlement for legacy
New v2 scorer adapter emits existing contest schema; do not call old v1 scorer timing fallback for v2
Lifecycle.beginExecution must deliberately carry the version/input binding; arbitrary added pre-execution field is currently dropped
Non-force home/tag and culpable positioning errors need separate contract evidence before broad enablement
